VI.description: Asks the window hwnd to draw itself into the device context hdcBlt through user32.dll PrintWindow (stdcall\2C called in any thread). With nFlags 2 PW_RENDERFULLCONTENT the window's own content is captured whether or not it is visible\2C covered or on another monitor - also a layered window with alpha 0. hdcBlt is normally a memory DC with a bitmap of the window's size selected into it. return value is the Win32 BOOL\3A non-zero on success\2C 0 on failure. When error in carries an error the DLL is not called. Generated by scripts\5CBuild Win32 Wrappers.vi - do not edit by hand\2C rebuild it.

Control.description: Device context the window is drawn into (HDC)\2C at its top-left corner.
0 the whole window\2C 1 PW_CLIENTONLY\2C 2 PW_RENDERFULLCONTENT (also content drawn by DirectComposition).
When this carries an error the DLL is not called and the error is passed to error out.

Indicator.description: error in\2C or the Call Library Function Node's own error.
